name: Subsidized housing for people with disabilities (BC Housing Housing Registry, rent geared to income, specially modified homes)
who: B.C. residents with a disability (recognized disability pension or DTC), able to live independently with community supports, household income under Housing Income Limits, assets under $100,000
what: Rent about 30% of gross household income in subsidized buildings; includes specially modified homes; one Housing Registry application
reason: Catalogue has RAP and SAFER only; no subsidized-housing record for people with disabilities

name: Children's Rehabilitation Services (Children's Treatment Centres, SmartStart Hubs, preschool speech and language)
who: Children and youth up to 19 (21 if in school) with physical or developmental disabilities or communication disorders; no referral needed
what: Free-to-access physiotherapy, occupational therapy, speech-language therapy, equipment help, SmartStart Hubs, family supports such as respite and parent coaching (page does not state cost)
reason: No Children's Treatment Centre or Special Needs Strategy record in the Ontario list

name: Child Care Subsidy
who: Families with K-grade 6 children, income under $90,000; special needs of parent or child is a qualifying reason
reason: General child care subsidy, no disability-specific criteria or amounts; special needs is only one qualifying reason. Optional low-priority add if owner wants it.

name: Seniors Lodge Program
what: Capital funding to lodge builders (fetched page); no resident eligibility or disability criteria
reason: Page is operator capital funding only; resident-level lodge assistance has no fetched official page

name: Transportation Supplement (PWD, $52/month)
what: Choose $52 per month or annual bus pass
reason: Same page and choice; folded into BC Bus Pass Program (verify record mentions the $52 cash option)

name: WorkBC / Community Inclusion / employment programs
what: Employment services and Training Initiative Supplement
reason: WorkBC records exist; Training Initiative Supplement is a minor item not confirmed as a separate record

name: B.C. Seniors Supplement / MSP premium assistance
reason: Seniors Supplement already decided not built; MSP premiums were eliminated in 2020

name: Assistive Devices Program categories (oxygen, diabetic supplies, hearing, visual, communication aids, etc.)
who: Ontario residents with 6+ month physical disability

name: Community housing (rent-geared-to-income, modified units)
reason: Run by municipal service managers, not disability-specific; no provincial eligibility page was fetched (searches returned only municipal pages). Owner may reconsider.
